scope: Savor selected preset: direct read-only browser-rendered observations plus attributed third-party automated scan report; no VSN interaction or accessibility tests.

claims.observed: Rendered product page displays 1/2/3/6 bottle pack choices, quantity and purchase controls; rendered collection displays price/availability/sort controls; empty cart displays shopping recovery and recommendations.
claims.risk: DOM presence does not prove that the options update price correctly, cart controls work or recommendations finish loading.
claims.vsn_guard: Keep package quantity and selected-variant pricing legible; test the complete variant/cart flow in an authorized test environment before claiming it works.

claims.observed: AccessifyAI reports an automated scan of Savor v4.2.0 on 2026-09-29 across four pages, with 8 issue types and 65 occurrences among the criteria its index reports.
claims.risk: Third-party automated scan coverage is limited and is not a VSN-run audit, certification or complete WCAG review.
claims.vsn_guard: Treat as a manual QA prompt only; run VSN keyboard, screen-reader and automated audits separately before making accessibility claims.
